steps.why: Compilers, libraries and an agent, each in a default session of its own: it installs alone and works at once. A library installs no compiler: cc, installed after it, links the programs. A package that needs a module default does not declare has nena enable it, as SDL2's audio@0 and touch@0.

steps.script: mkdir /tmp/amy-cmake && cd /tmp/amy-cmake && printf 'int main(void) { return 0; }\n' > main.c && printf '%s\n' 'cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)' 'project(probe C)' 'add_executable(probe main.c)' > CMakeLists.txt && cmake -B build -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-O0 && cmake --build build && build/probe

steps.why: A timer writes into a pipe whose other end the same loop watches.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <event2/event.h>' '#include <unistd.h>' 'static void heard(evutil_socket_t end, short what, void *seen) { char byte; *(int *)seen += read(end, &byte, 1) == 1 && byte == *"p"; }' 'static void fire(evutil_socket_t none, short what, void *end) { write(*(int *)end, "p", 1); }' 'int main(void) { int ends[2], seen = 0; struct timeval soon = { 0, 1000 }; struct event_base *base = event_base_new(); if (base == NULL || pipe(ends) != 0) return 2; event_base_once(base, ends[0], EV_READ, heard, &seen, NULL); event_base_once(base, -1, EV_TIMEOUT, fire, &ends[1], &soon); return event_base_dispatch(base) < 0 || seen != 1; }' > /tmp/amy-event.c && cc -O0 /tmp/amy-event.c -levent_core -o /tmp/amy-event && /tmp/amy-event

steps.why: The description of the display's terminal, and a cursor address written from it. The stack is dirtied first: the address is formatted from the numbers given, not from what lay there.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <term.h>' '#include <string.h>' 'static void dirty(void) { volatile char stack[16384]; memset((char *)stack, 255, sizeof(stack)); }' 'int main(void) { int error; if (setupterm("xterm-256color", 1, &error) != OK) return 2; dirty(); return tigetnum("colors") != 256 || strcmp(tiparm(tigetstr("cup"), 4, 9), "\033[5;10H") != 0; }' > /tmp/amy-term.c && cc -O0 /tmp/amy-term.c -lterminfo -o /tmp/amy-term && /tmp/amy-term

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <SDL.h>' '#include <SDL_mixer.h>' 'int main(void) { static Uint8 silence[48000 * 4 / 4]; if (SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO | SDL_INIT_AUDIO) != 0 || !SDL_CreateWindow("", 0, 0, 64, 48, 0) || Mix_OpenAudio(48000, AUDIO_S16SYS, 2, 1024) != 0) return 2; Mix_Chunk *chunk = Mix_QuickLoad_RAW(silence, sizeof silence); if (!chunk || Mix_PlayChannel(-1, chunk, 0) < 0) return 3; for (Uint32 start = SDL_GetTicks(); Mix_Playing(-1) && SDL_GetTicks() - start < 5000; SDL_Delay(10)) SDL_PumpEvents(); int ended = !Mix_Playing(-1); Mix_CloseAudio(); SDL_Quit(); return !ended; }' > /tmp/amy-mixer.c && cc $(pkg-config --cflags SDL2_mixer) /tmp/amy-mixer.c $(pkg-config --static --libs SDL2_mixer) -o /tmp/amy-mixer && /tmp/amy-mixer

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <SDL_ttf.h>' 'int main(void) { SDL_Color white = { 255, 255, 255, 255 }; if (TTF_Init() != 0) return 2; TTF_Font *font = TTF_OpenFont("/usr/share/fonts/IosevkaTerm-SemiBold.ttf", 24); if (font == NULL) return 3; SDL_Surface *text = TTF_RenderUTF8_Blended(font, "Dolly", white); if (text == NULL || text->w < 40) return 4; Uint32 *pixel = text->pixels; int inked = 0; for (int i = 0; i < text->pitch / 4 * text->h; i++) inked += pixel[i] >> 24 > 128; return inked < 50; }' > /tmp/amy-ttf.c && cc $(pkg-config --cflags SDL2_ttf) /tmp/amy-ttf.c $(pkg-config --static --libs SDL2_ttf) -o /tmp/amy-ttf && /tmp/amy-ttf

steps.why: One frame drawn by raylib's software renderer and shown through Dolly's adapter. As raylib's examples are written: InitWindow holds the display and the keys, and the clock and the frame time run (the page presses Space after these steps). Fingers are raylib's touch points, the first also its mouse (the page puts two down).

steps.script:
printf '%s
' '#include <dolly/raylib.h>' 'int main(void) { dolly_raylib window; if (dolly_raylib_open(&window, "amy") != 0) return 2; BeginDrawing(); ClearBackground(RAYWHITE); DrawCircle(64, 64, 32, RED); int shown = dolly_raylib_end_frame(&window); return dolly_raylib_close(&window) != 0 || shown != 0; }' > /tmp/amy-raylib.c && cc -O0 /tmp/amy-raylib.c -ldolly-raylib -lraylib -lm -o /tmp/amy-raylib && /tmp/amy-raylib > /dev/null && printf '%s
' '#include <raylib.h>' '#include <stdio.h>' 'int main(void) { InitWindow(320, 180, "keys"); SetTargetFPS(60); int frames = 0, pressed = 0; while (!WindowShouldClose() && !pressed && frames < 3600) { BeginDrawing(); ClearBackground(RAYWHITE); EndDrawing(); frames++; pressed = IsKeyPressed(KEY_SPACE); } printf("after %d frames %.3f s, frame %.4f s
", frames, GetTime(), GetFrameTime()); CloseWindow(); return !(pressed && GetTime() > 0.1 && GetFrameTime() > 0); }' > /tmp/amy-raylib-keys.c && cc -O0 /tmp/amy-raylib-keys.c -lraylib -lm -o /tmp/amy-raylib-keys && printf '%s
' '#include <raylib.h>' 'int main(void) { InitWindow(320, 180, "touch"); SetTargetFPS(60); int frames = 0, most = 0, released = 0; while (!WindowShouldClose() && !(most == 2 && released) && frames < 3600) { BeginDrawing(); ClearBackground(RAYWHITE); EndDrawing(); frames++; if (GetTouchPointCount() > most) most = GetTouchPointCount(); released = IsMouseButtonReleased(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT); } CloseWindow(); return !(most == 2 && released); }' > /tmp/amy-raylib-touch.c && cc -O0 /tmp/amy-raylib-touch.c -lraylib -lm -o /tmp/amy-raylib-touch

steps.why: A square wave played from a buffer is in the samples the loopback device renders.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#define AL_ALEXT_PROTOTYPES' '#include <AL/al.h>' '#include <AL/alc.h>' '#include <AL/alext.h>' 'int main() { ALCdevice *device = alcLoopbackOpenDeviceSOFT(0); int format[] = { ALC_FORMAT_CHANNELS_SOFT, ALC_MONO_SOFT, ALC_FORMAT_TYPE_SOFT, ALC_SHORT_SOFT, ALC_FREQUENCY, 48000, 0 }; alcMakeContextCurrent(alcCreateContext(device, format)); short wave[4800], heard[4800]; int loud = 0; ALuint buffer, source; for (int at = 0; at < 4800; at++) wave[at] = at % 100 < 50 ? 12000 : -12000; alGenBuffers(1, &buffer); alGenSources(1, &source); alBufferData(buffer, AL_FORMAT_MONO16, wave, sizeof wave, 48000); alSourcei(source, AL_BUFFER, buffer); alSourcePlay(source); alcRenderSamplesSOFT(device, heard, 4800); for (int at = 0; at < 4800; at++) loud += heard[at] > 1000 || heard[at] < -1000; return loud < 2400 || alGetError() != AL_NO_ERROR; }' > /tmp/amy-openal.cpp && c++ -O0 /tmp/amy-openal.cpp -lopenal -o /tmp/amy-openal && /tmp/amy-openal
